targets.query:
from(bucket: "performance")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "performance_http_request")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "response_time_ms")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with transaction: if exists r.transaction then r.transaction else "unknown" }))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.testRunID =~ /^${testRunID:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.transaction =~ /^${transaction:regex}$/)
  |> window(every: v.windowPeriod)
  |> quantile(q: ${pct:raw}, method: "estimate_tdigest")
  |> duplicate(column: "_stop", as: "_time")
  |> window(every: inf)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, _value: r._value, _field: r.testRunID }))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> yield(name: "p${pct:text}")

panels.title: P${pct:text} response time by test run

targets.query:
from(bucket: "performance")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "performance_http_request")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "response_time_ms")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with transaction: if exists r.transaction then r.transaction else "unknown" }))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.testRunID =~ /^${testRunID:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.transaction =~ /^${transaction:regex}$/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: count, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: float(v: r._value) / (float(v: uint(v: r._stop) - uint(v: r._start)) / 1000000000.0) }))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, _value: r._value, _field: r.testRunID }))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> yield(name: "mean")

panels.title: P${pct:text} response time by transaction and test run

targets.query:
seconds = float(v: uint(v: v.timeRangeStop) - uint(v: v.timeRangeStart)) / 1000000000.0

base = from(bucket: "performance")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "performance_http_request")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "response_time_ms")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.testRunID =~ /^${testRunID:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.transaction =~ /^${transaction:regex}$/)

pctResponse = base
  |> group(columns: ["testRunID", "transaction"])
  |> quantile(q: ${pct:raw}, method: "estimate_tdigest")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ transaction: r.transaction, _field: r.testRunID + " p${pct:text} response time ms", _value: r._value }))

sampleCount = base
  |> group(columns: ["testRunID", "transaction"])
  |> count()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ transaction: r.transaction, _field: r.testRunID + " samples", _value: float(v: r._value) }))

requestsPerSecond = base
  |> group(columns: ["testRunID", "transaction"])
  |> count()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ transaction: r.transaction, _field: r.testRunID + " requests/sec", _value: float(v: r._value) / seconds }))

errorRate = from(bucket: "performance")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "performance_http_request")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "failed")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.testRunID =~ /^${testRunID:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.transaction =~ /^${transaction:regex}$/)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: if r._value then 1.0 else 0.0 }))
  |> group(columns: ["testRunID", "transaction"])
  |> mean()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ transaction: r.transaction, _field: r.testRunID + " error rate", _value: r._value }))

union(tables: [pctResponse, sampleCount, requestsPerSecond, errorRate])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["transaction"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["transaction"])

panels.title: Status code comparison by test run

targets.query:
statusByPoint = from(bucket: "performance")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "performance_http_request")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "status_code")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.testRunID =~ /^${testRunID:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.transaction =~ /^${transaction:regex}$/)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, testRunID: r.testRunID, transaction: r.transaction, status_code: r._value }))

failedByPoint = from(bucket: "performance")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "performance_http_request")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "failed")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.testRunID =~ /^${testRunID:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.transaction =~ /^${transaction:regex}$/)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, testRunID: r.testRunID, transaction: r.transaction, failed: if r._value then 1.0 else 0.0 }))

wide = join(tables: {status: statusByPoint, failed: failedByPoint}, on: ["_time", "testRunID", "transaction"])

samples = wide
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ transaction: r.transaction, status_code: r.status_code, _field: r.testRunID + " samples", _value: 1.0 }))
  |> group(columns: ["transaction", "status_code", "_field"])
  |> sum()

errors = wide
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ transaction: r.transaction, status_code: r.status_code, _field: r.testRunID + " error samples", _value: r.failed }))
  |> group(columns: ["transaction", "status_code", "_field"])
  |> sum()

rates = wide
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ transaction: r.transaction, status_code: r.status_code, _field: r.testRunID + " error rate", _value: r.failed }))
  |> group(columns: ["transaction", "status_code", "_field"])
  |> mean()

union(tables: [samples, errors, rates])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["transaction", "status_code"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["transaction", "status_code"])
